policies.vertex_link: one_connected_multigraph_cycle_or_path; loose-edge nodes at surface vertices included; pure wires and isolated vertices classified separately
policies.duplicate_face_vertex_link: vertices touching duplicate cyclic polygons are unclassified, never reported normal
policies.vertex_clusters: connected via original edges restricted to flagged vertices
policies.degenerate_triangle: exact_binary_value_cross_squared <= 2^-80 * max_squared_edge_length^2; exact zero distinguished from relative near
policies.ngon: exact collinearity for all arities; otherwise only simple exactly planar polygons with at most 64 corners; near-ngon quality not checked
policies.polygon_clusters: flagged original polygons sharing a source edge
policies.positions: local metres and world metres through original affine matrix then unit scale; full patch-vertex AABB and one source-indexed witness; binary64 forward map, no certified error bound
policies.position_failure: nonfinite arithmetic or exhausted budget returns unknown positions and partial outer result without discarding completed topology facts
policies.output_version: raw-mesh-structure-v2 with explicit algorithm policies, unclassified indices and position status; old public pair/query contracts remain unchanged

quality.unknown: retained_in_original_full_task_denominator; explicitly registered out-of-domain category rows scored separately
quality.source_repeated_vertex_polygon: still refused before classification; not silently repaired
